backend/main.mo: Main actor for the Smileup backend, defining data types and state for posts, comments, user profiles, follows, likes, notifications, messages, and friend requests, with authorization and blob storage mixins included.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that upgrades user profiles from the old schema (without bannerImage) to the new schema by adding a null bannerImage field.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: fixing the 'failed to update profile' error and fixing the banner upload button on the profile page, both targeting ProfilePage.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and notable fixes.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that sets up Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app with the page title set to 'Smileup' and a root div for mounting the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in ThemeProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and QueryClientProvider, showing a loading splash, LandingPage for unauthenticated users, or the full router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component supporting multiple sizes, gradient initials fallback, ExternalBlob image display, an optional gradient ring, and legacy prop aliases (profilePicture, userId, displayName).
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six nav items (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile), active state highlighting, and a message indicator dot; hidden on the ShortSport route.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and adding comments on a post, fetching comments via query hooks and submitting new ones with the caller's profile name.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: An editor panel for managing audio tracks, allowing users to upload audio files or toggle a recording state, with per-track volume, mute, and delete controls.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: A React panel component for editing canvas design properties including aspect ratio, background color/gradient presets, shape overlays, and decorative elements. Allows users to apply solid colors or gradient presets to the first clip and add shapes to the editor state.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: A canvas-based rendering component that draws the current video frame including background color, sticker layers, text layers, vignette, glitch, and letterbox effects using the HTML5 Canvas API. Reads from EditorState to determine what to render at the current playback time.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: A timeline UI component that displays video/image/blank clips on a scrollable ruler with a draggable playhead, supports scrubbing, clip removal, and adding new blank clips. Clip positions and widths are calculated based on a zoom-adjusted pixels-per-second scale.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: A panel component for toggling visual motion graphics effects (confetti, glitch, letterbox, film grain, etc.) on the editor state. Displays active effects as tags and shows a placeholder message when none are selected.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: A panel component for exporting and sharing a video clip, providing title/description metadata fields, a video preview, and a download button that creates a blob URL. Informs users to use 'Create Post' for public sharing.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: A panel component offering filter presets (moody, cinematic, noir, etc.) and individual slider controls for brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, vignette, and other image adjustments. Applies preset or custom filter settings to the EditorState filters object.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: A React panel component for adding and managing emoji sticker layers on a video editor, supporting categorized emoji selection, size/rotation/timing controls, and sticker deletion.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: A React panel component for adding and managing text overlay layers in a video editor, with controls for font, color, size, alignment, animation, bold/italic, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: A React panel component that displays a library of video transitions and allows applying them between consecutive clips in the editor state.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, a router Outlet for page content, and a BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel that lists user notifications with icons, timestamps, and unread counts, and marks notifications as read on click.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Displays a single post with media, caption, like/unlike, comment, share, and bookmark actions, using optimistic UI updates for likes.
A dialog modal showing a grid of posts for selection, supporting both image and video thumbnails with a highlight on the selected item.
frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx: A dialog for sharing a post with friends via direct message or copying a link, with multi-friend selection and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/StoriesRow.tsx: A horizontally scrollable row of story avatars using mock data, with a 'Your Story' button that opens a popup for viewing posts or creating new ones.
frontend/src/components/StoryViewerModal: A full-screen modal overlay that displays a single story with a progress bar, user avatar, handle, timestamp, and story content. Closes on Escape key press or backdrop click.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A sticky top navigation bar showing the Smileup wordmark, notification bell with unread badge, search button, and sign-out option. Hides on the '/shortsport' route.
frontend/src/components/TrendingProfiles: A horizontally scrollable section displaying the top 10 trending creators with rank badges, avatars, handles, and follower counts fetched via useGetTopCreators.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, play button, duration badge, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, and a follow button for unfollowed users.
frontend/src/components/YourStoryPopup.t: A small dropdown popup anchored below a trigger element offering two actions: viewing the user's own posts or creating a new post. Closes when clicking outside.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TypeScript types and React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, posts, comments, notifications, messages, friendships, and creator rankings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives, imports Inter and Syne fonts, and defines light/dark mode CSS custom properties (colors, radius, glass effects) plus utility classes like scrollbar-hide and gold gradient text.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and mock data arrays for Posts, Comments, Users, Stories, Messages, and Conversations used for frontend development and testing.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions for class merging (cn), number formatting (K/M), time formatting (mm:ss), and relative time display (timeAgo).
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating new posts supporting text, image, and video types, with file selection, upload progress tracking, and submission via the createPost mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page with panel-based tools (trim, filters, effects, stickers, design, export), managing editor state including clips, text layers, sticker layers, audio tracks, and filter settings.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore/search page with debounced user search, displaying user result cards and post thumbnails in a tabbed grid layout using backend query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the main social feed with stories, trending profiles, and a sorted list of posts fetched via React Query hooks, showing skeleton loaders while loading and an empty state when no posts exist.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing/login page for the Smileup app featuring a gradient wordmark, tagline, Internet Identity login button with loading state, and feature highlight cards.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging UI with a conversation list sidebar, per-conversation message thread view, message bubbles, and the ability to start new conversations with followed users.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper that extracts a principalId route param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected as the initial conversation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Editable profile page for the authenticated user, supporting banner and profile photo uploads, an edit modal for name/bio/location fields, and tabbed views for posts and liked content.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical reel viewer that auto-plays video or image posts one at a time, with like, comment, share, mute, and follow/unfollow actions per reel.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Public profile page for any user showing their avatar, banner, stats, follow/unfollow toggle, friend request actions, and a grid of their posts.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines the TanStack Router route tree for the frontend, mapping URL paths to page components including Feed, Explore, Editor, Profile, ShortSport, CreatePost, UserProfile, Messages, and MessageThread.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, typography/container-queries/animate plugins, custom fonts (Inter, Syne), border radii, and box shadows.
project_state.json: Tracks project state at version 3, documenting two known issues to fix: a 'failed to update profile' error on save and a non-functional banner upload/change button on the profile page.
